title: The Keeper's Hill
style: Soft watercolour on rough paper, muted blues and greys, one warm light in every picture.

characters.name: The keeper
characters.description: A man of about sixty with a short grey beard, a navy wool coat with brass buttons and a knitted cap. He carries a brass lantern.

scenes.narration: The keeper climbed the same hill every morning. Nobody asked him to.
scenes.image_prompt: Dawn. The keeper climbs a steep green hill toward the lighthouse at its top, seen from below so that he is small against a pale sky. He leans into the slope, lantern in his right hand, its flame the one warm light. Wet grass, a narrow worn path, sea mist behind the hill. Low angle, wide lens, soft early light from the left.
scenes.motion_prompt: The keeper walks slowly up the path, the grass bends in the wind, mist drifts to the right. The camera holds still. Slow.

scenes.narration: He trimmed the wick, cleaned the glass, and wrote one line in the log. Then he did it all again.
scenes.image_prompt: The lamp room at the top of the lighthouse. Close on the keeper's hands as he wipes the big glass lens with a cloth, the brass fittings around it dull and well used. An open logbook and a pencil on the sill. The lamp's flame is the one warm light and it glows through the lens onto his fingers. Eye level, close lens, shallow focus.
scenes.motion_prompt: His hand moves the cloth across the glass in a slow circle, the flame flickers gently. The camera holds still. Slow.

scenes.narration: Years passed. Then one night a storm took the stars, and a ship lost its way.
scenes.image_prompt: Night. A storm over a black sea, sheets of rain, no stars. A small ship far out, half hidden between two tall waves, one warm lamp at its mast. Heavy cloud, cold blue-grey water with white crests. Wide shot from above the waves, long lens.
scenes.motion_prompt: The waves roll from left to right, the ship rises and drops between them, rain falls at a slant. The camera sways slightly with the sea. Medium speed.

scenes.narration: The lamp was burning, as it had every night before. Because of one small habit, the ship came home.
scenes.image_prompt: The beam of the lighthouse cuts across the dark water in one warm bar of light, and the small ship has turned its bow toward it. The lighthouse stands at the right edge on its hill, rain thinning. The beam is the one warm light. Wide shot at sea level, normal lens.
scenes.motion_prompt: The beam sweeps slowly across the water toward the ship, the ship moves toward the light. Slow push in.

scenes.image_prompt: The same steep green hill at dawn, empty and calm, the lighthouse at its top. Nobody on the path. The sea flat and pale, the sky clearing. The first sun on the lighthouse glass is the one warm light. Seen from below, wide lens, the same view as the first picture.
scenes.motion_prompt: Grass moves lightly, a few gulls cross the sky far away. The camera holds still. Very slow.
